name: remuxing-to-mov
description: Losslessly remux broadcast and web captures (.ts, .mpg/.vob, .mkv, broken .mov) into verified QuickTime-ready .mov — stream copy first, an escalation ladder of measured timeline repairs, an operator-attested re-encode as the only lossy path, and the source file never touched — plus a source clinic that checks and corrects the capture in its own container (zero-base, deterministic surgical cuts, lead-in detection) without remuxing at all. Every build is verified (packet/essence identity, timeline, scrub, A/V parity, audio playability, macOS playability/fidelity) and every codec/container claim is re-measured on a named bench in a claims registry that records its own reversals; version history lives in CHANGELOG.md.
